BiblicalUsage: Rezon son of Eliadah fled from his master Hadadezer king of Zobah, gathered men unto him, and became captain over a band and reigned in Damascus, an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon. He reigned in Damascus and was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, as God had raised him up.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced that God raised up adversaries to Solomon when Solomon's heart turned, and Rezon is the proof that no king outruns his own turning.
RelatedPeople: Rezon, King of Damascus; King Solomon
